self_check: each UPDATE records its row count in a temporary table; a DO block before COMMIT raises unless every statement changed exactly 1 row, which aborts the transaction (COMMIT then rolls back)
identifier_note: OPD's hash is sha256(body_key + parent_type + url); the relink documents carry parent_type 'agenda', so moving them to an affair changes the hash and the files.openparldata.ch/doc URL unless OPD keeps the old identifier (--hash keep)
